legacy.why: None of the legacy programs in either built module can execute in this environment. Phase 1 (F7919070,F7919100,F7919270,F7918030,F791TRAC): F7919070/F7919100/F7919270 hit a GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 restriction (REDEFINES field not allowed in PROCEDURE DIVISION USING), F7918030 requires a DB2 precompiler not installed here, F791TRAC calls 3 external programs (F7919220, F791CICS, F791MQS0) not present in this repo slice. Phase 2 (F115ICA0,F115ICH0,F115ICT0,F115IHI0,F115IMC0,F115IPA0,F115IPC0,F115ISC0,F115ISR0,F5879010): the 9 DBI modules embed EXEC SQL, also requiring a DB2 precompiler not installed here; F5879010 hits the same GnuCOBOL REDEFINES restriction. See each module's own TRANSFORMATION_NOTES.md 'Equivalence basis' section for detail. The fresh-input dual-execution check (verify Step 4) could not be performed for either module for this reason: there is no legacy side to run inputs against, so proof for both modules is trace-based (hand-traced characterization tests) only.

leftOut: Fresh-input dual-execution check (verify Step 4) was not attempted for either module: the legacy side cannot run here at all (see legacy.why above), so no legacy output exists to diff a fresh input against. Inventing a substitute legacy output was not done, per the rule against improving evidence by hand.
Malformed-record inputs were not tried for the same reason (no legacy side to observe tolerating them against).
